body: Release history: v0.1.0 2026-09-24 (first, volt release, 5 archives + checksums.txt, no windows/arm64 archive by volt's default list); v0.2.0 2026-09-24 sessions move (retracted, release page deleted, tag kept); v0.2.1 2026-09-25 keychain fix + retract; v0.3.0 2026-09-26 agx plan + Codex JWT expiry; v0.3.1 2026-10-14 pickers + profile column (last laptop release); v0.3.2 2026-10-14 first tag-push CI release; v0.3.3 2026-10-16 logins (PR #1 merged 2026-10-17).
